## PreflightCheckError.backendType property

The unregistered backend type named in `backends[].type`<!-- -->, present only for a `'config-unknown-backend'` failure. Lets a consumer echo the offending type in its remediation without parsing the `reason` prose.

**Signature:**

```typescript
backendType?: string | undefined;
```
